title: Typing Matters: Muscle, Language and Typing Behaviour in Live Keystroke Decoding from sEMG
abstract: arXiv:2611.18464v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Surface electromyography (sEMG) from the wrists can recover typed text without a keyboard. It is usually posed as a signal-inference problem: characters are read out of the muscle signal and character error rate is reported offline. We argue that this framing removes most of the problem. The decoder is constrained simultaneously by the muscles, by the language being typed, and by typing behaviour such as typos, corrections, backspaces and line breaks, and a usable system must predict keys live while the hand keeps moving. Existing systems fall short on two counts: (1) they process sEMG in fixed windows and carry nothing from one window to the next, discarding context accumulated over a session, and (2) they lack any understanding of the linguistic structure that drives typing, so every keystroke is inferred from the muscle signal alone. translated_title: 打字至关重要：基于sEMG实时按键解码中的肌肉、语言与打字行为
translated_abstract: 来自手腕的表面肌电信号（sEMG）可以在没有键盘的情况下恢复打出的文本。这通常被表述为一个信号推断问题：从肌肉信号中读出字符，并离线报告字符错误率。我们认为这种框架忽略了问题的大部分内容。解码器同时受到肌肉、正在输入的语言以及打字行为（如拼写错误、纠正、退格和换行）的约束，而一个可用的系统必须在手部持续移动时实时预测按键。现有系统在两个方面存在不足：（1）它们以固定窗口处理sEMG信号，且不在窗口之间传递任何信息，丢弃了在整个会话中积累的上下文；（2）它们缺乏对驱动打字的语言结构的理解，因此每一次按键都仅凭肌肉信号进行推断。我们提出了一种完全因果的、零前瞻的基于状态空间模型（SSM）的sEMG打字解码器……
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于状态空间模型（SSM）的完全因果、零前瞻sEMG打字解码器，将肌肉信号、语言结构与打字行为三者联合建模，实现手部持续移动时的实时按键预测。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a fully causal, zero-lookahead sEMG typing decoder built on a state space model, jointly modeling muscle signals, linguistic structure, and typing behaviour to enable live keystroke prediction while the hand keeps moving.
